# SMS Manager error catalog

Every error returned by any SMS Manager service, adapter, or handler uses one
of the `SMS-xxxx` codes below (ARCHITECTURE.md §12). Clients must branch on
`code`/`class`, never on message text.

This catalog is intentionally partial: it currently covers the `SMS-1xxx`
(auth) and `SMS-9xxx` (internal) ranges only, enough to prove the
generation pipeline. `SMS-2xxx`..`SMS-5xxx` are filled in as Phase 1
provider and API stories land.

| Code | Class | HTTP status | Retryable | Title | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SMS-1001` | `CLIENT` | 401 | false | Missing or invalid token | The request has no bearer token, or the token is malformed/expired/invalid. |
| `SMS-1002` | `CLIENT` | 403 | false | Insufficient role | The caller is authenticated but lacks the role/scope required for this operation. |
| `SMS-1003` | `RETRYABLE` | 503 | true | Auth service unavailable | Keycloak (or the token introspection path) could not be reached in time. |
| `SMS-9001` | `RETRYABLE` | 500 | true | Internal error | An unexpected internal failure occurred; see trace_id for correlation. |
| `SMS-9002` | `RETRYABLE` | 503 | true | Dependency unavailable | A required dependency (database, queue, cache) is unavailable or timed out. |
| `SMS-9003` | `RETRYABLE` | 502 | true | All providers unavailable | Every eligible SMS provider failed or was unavailable for this send. |
